title: File stored in FileStorage but not updating
author: sheryever

comments.body: Hi @sheryever, try position you MemoryStream to 0 before call Upload method. LiteDB doesnt touch in start position. If you write on MemoryStream and flush(), position in on end and when you call Upload there is no more bytes to write.

satisfaction_conditions: A solution that correctly updates existing files in FileStorage
Guidance on proper stream position management when uploading files
An explanation of how the FileStorage upload method interacts with stream positions

_classification.category: Can be dockerized without any issue

dockerfile:
FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:3.1

# Set working directory
WORKDIR /app

# Install git and required dependencies
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y git wget apt-transport-https gnupg && \
    # Install Mono using the correct repository for Debian 10 (buster)
    apt-key adv --keyserver hkp://keyserver.ubuntu.com:80 --recv-keys 3FA7E0328081BFF6A14DA29AA6A19B38D3D831EF && \
    echo "deb https://download.mono-project.com/repo/debian stable-buster main" | tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/mono-official-stable.list && \
    apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y mono-complete mono-devel msbuild referenceassemblies-pcl && \
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Create a temporary directory for cloning
WORKDIR /tmp/clone

# Clone the repository and checkout specific commit
RUN git clone https://github.com/litedb-org/LiteDB.git . && \
    git checkout eb94a2a3f2858a5e156d198df30cdbab8d7fb2fe

# Copy the source to the app directory
RUN mkdir -p /app && \
    cp -R * /app/

# Return to the app directory
WORKDIR /app

# Build the LiteDB.dll project
RUN dotnet restore LiteDB/LiteDB.csproj && \
    msbuild LiteDB/LiteDB.csproj /p:Configuration=Release

# Create a directory for users to mount their test files
RUN mkdir -p /app/test

# Set the working directory to the test directory
WORKDIR /app/test
